name: M3-1D-21,1B
headline: Enticing & Earthy 1 BDR @ Mangroovy | Free Pool & Beach Access
summary: This earthy 1 bedroom apartment is located in Gouna's only beachfront community with free pool and beach access and is managed by Xuru Stays

description.Space:
This neat 1 bedroom apartment is located in Gouna's only beachfront residence - Mangroovy with a free pool and beach access. Mangroovy is closest to the Marina (10 min walk). 

The apartment is on the second floor and features an open plan fully equipped kitchen, 2 bathrooms (one ensuite) and a living room with a sofa bed that can sleep up to 2 additional guests. 

It also features a 55 inch smart TV with Airplay and cable channels, washing machine, a Nespresso machine, kettle and a microwave. The apartment is great for couples & small families. 

The styling of the apartment is tailored to give the guests a soothing and happy vibe.


At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment
description.Interaction:
We are more than happy to answer all of your questions 24/7. Guests can text and call anytime they need help and our team will be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Neighborhood:
-Mangroovy residence is uniquely located 800 meters from Marina El Gouna. Guests will be able to walk 10 minutes and get to it. 
-'Bright Star' supermarket is right in front of the residence towards the Marina.
-Mangroovy is home to the famous 'Noi' beach lounge (located at Mangroovy's beach)
- 'The Smokery', a local favorite is also located 450 meters from the residence.
description.Transit:
Free outdoor parking is available. 
Tuktuks are available to take you anywhere in El Gouna (flat fee 20 EGP).
description.Notes: Please note that smoking is not allowed inside the apartment. A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.

agreement:
• Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 100 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 


Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

Check-in was very disappointing, with many issues upon arrival. The toilets were dirty, there was no soap in several places, towels were missing, and the final cleaning had clearly not been completed. There was soap residue left in the toilet cabin, and hair from previous guests was still stuck on the shower wall, which showed that the apartment had not been properly cleaned.
Trash bags were missing, and all mirrors in the apartment were dirty and covered with spots. Xuru sent a helper, but without any list of the reported issues, so I had to personally show everything that needed to be fixed.
The apartment also clearly needs some care and maintenance, as it feels worn and neglected.
The morning after check-in, I was woken up by loud construction noise, without any prior notice from Xuru.
I do not recommend this place, as the price does not match the standard. I decided to extend my stay somewhere else with a better view, higher standard, and lower price.

Positive:
Die Lage ist super. Strand, Pool, Supermarkt, Apotheke ist alles vor der Haustür. Restaurants sind in der nächsten Marina und Eck.
Die Wohnung hat eine gute Aufteilung und sie ist wirklich hell und groß für zwei Zimmer und lädt ein, um sich wohl zu fühlen.
Der Balkon ist super für ein paar entspannte und schattige Momente.
Es gibt eine Waschmaschine, Microwelle, Wasserkocher, Kaffeemaschine, Kühlschrank usw.
Die Küche ist gut ausgestattet, um auch selbst zu kochen.
WiFi hat einwandfrei funktioniert.
Die A/C in beiden Räumen war super und getrennt voneinander regulierbar.
Es wurde alle paar Tage bei mir nachgefragt, ob alles in Ordnung sei und ob man mir mit etwas zur Hand gehen könne.
Ich hab mich wirklich super umsorgt gefühlt, obwohl man keinen face to face Kontakt hat.

Negative:
Direkt neben der Wohnung ist die Personalkontrolle und die Zufahrt von dem Hotel daneben. Es wird daher tagsüber und nachts gerne mal kurzzeitig etwas lauter.
Da die Wohnung direkt neben der Straße liegt, konnte ich während meines Aufenthaltes mehrfach nächtliche Straßenrennen hören.
Thank you

They were great, super responsive and easy to deal with. I actually made the booking just one day before arriving, and they were incredibly helpful throughout. The unit is in a perfect location, within walking distance of everything, whether it’s Fanadir or the new Mangroovy food court.

They also added a really nice touch by leaving coffee and a bottle of water for us, which I genuinely appreciated. The price was very fair too, actually cheaper than most other options I found.

Overall, it was a really nice experience, and definitely won’t be the last. Till we meet again, guys. Cheers!
Thanks for everything, Xuru Stays was extremely helpful in everything
